name: DevilHack
source:
•Browse on a computer equipped with a somewhat special hacking tool...
•Check out what's going on on DevilBook.
•Find out what you can do for other people.
•Have fun hacking the cameras of the surrounding places.
With the new dlc, follow a parallel adventure :)

[From [url=https://devileroki.itch.io/devilhack]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
•在配备某种特殊黑客工具的计算机上浏览……
•查看DevilBook上发生了什么。
•找出你能为别人做些什么。
•享受破解周围地方摄像头的乐趣。
通过新的dlc，跟随平行的冒险:)

[来自[url=https://devileroki.itch.io/devilhack]Itch.io[/url]]
